note: SYNTHETIC ground truth for Rookwise benchmark incident inc-01, written by scripts/gen_incidents.py (seed 20261017). Fictional: every host, address, key, person and event is made up.
root_cause: The client certificate that billing-api presents to the payment gateway (pay-gw.example.net) expired at 03:40 UTC. The renewal job had skipped it (approval pending), so every TLS handshake to the gateway failed from 03:40 and invoice payments returned 502.

essential_evidence.quote: 2026-05-04T00:43:30.836Z WARN  billing-api[billing-1] tls: client certificate expires soon peer=pay-gw.example.net cert=pay-gw-client not_after=2026-05-04T03:40:00Z hours_left=2.9
essential_evidence.note: the gateway client certificate expires at 03:40

essential_evidence.quote: 2026-05-04T03:40:02.114Z ERROR billing-api[billing-3] tls: handshake failed peer=pay-gw.example.net reason=certificate_expired not_after=2026-05-04T03:40:00Z
essential_evidence.note: first handshake failure: the certificate has expired

supporting_evidence.quote: 2026-05-04T01:10:40.600Z INFO  billing-api[billing-2] scheduler: job finished name=cert-renew renewed=0 skipped=1 cert=pay-gw-client reason=approval_pending
supporting_evidence.note: the renewal job skipped this certificate

supporting_evidence.quote: 2026-05-04T03:40:31.507Z INFO  edge-proxy[edge-2] proxy: POST /v1/invoices/pay status=502 dur_ms=21 upstream=billing-api req=5a0c11e7

decoys.quote: 2026-05-04T02:57:13.080Z ERROR edge-proxy[edge-1] geoip: database update failed source=geoip-updates.example.org status=404
decoys.note: GeoIP update failure; payments do not use GeoIP
PDF renderer crash before the incident; it restarts and does not charge

decoys.quote: 2026-05-04T04:09:32.920Z ERROR billing-api[billing-1] db: replica lag high replica=reporting-1 lag_s=48 used_by=reports
decoys.note: the reporting replica lags; payments use the primary

acceptable_remediations: Renew or reissue the pay-gw-client certificate and reload billing-api
Approve the pending renewal so the cert-renew job rotates the certificate
Alert on client certificates that expire within 14 days
